_schema: Q420 (C257/R66), read by SpeakerAssignNewNameTests. `existing` is a names.json (byte-compatible schema) that does NOT hold `typed`. `typed` is the name the user types into the assign sheet (phone) / gutter popover (Mac) for a diarized 'Speaker 2'. `voiceprint` is the embedding learned from that speaker's turns. `expect`: after naming, the new person exists with `canonical`, at least `minAliases` aliases that include every entry of `aliasesContain`, and keeps the voiceprint; the existing roster is untouched.
